verified: The Senate passed BAAJA 62-33 as an amendment to H.R. 2347, after a 69-27 vote on Nov. 18 to substitute the bill's text and a 73-25 procedural vote on Nov. 9, pv magazine reported; the bill was introduced Sept. 30 by Senators Shelley Moore Capito, Mike Lee, Sheldon Whitehouse and Martin Heinrich.
unconfirmed: The specific mechanics — the 60-day delay threshold, 50%-100% damages range, the Nov. 6, 2026 permit cut-off date, the 150-day NEPA window, FERC's one-year state backstop and the 18-month behind-the-meter aggregation rule — come from a section-by-section summary by the Bipartisan Policy Center, not from bill text quoted in the report, and could change in the House; SEIA's estimate that the bill unlocks 167 GW of solar by 2035 is the trade group's own modeling, and the report gives no House vote date.

verified: 参议院以62比33通过作为 H.R. 2347 修正案的 BAAJA，此前11月18日以69比27同意替换文本，11月9日以73比25通过程序性投票；法案由 Capito、Lee、Whitehouse、Heinrich 四位参议员于9月30日提出。上述条款内容来自 BPC 对参议院通过文本的逐条摘要。
unconfirmed: 众议院是否放行、法案能否在1月初前成为法律；太阳能产业协会（SEIA）所称“2028至2035年新增167吉瓦太阳能、2035年占比超18%”是该行业协会自己的测算，未获独立验证；赔偿比例和60天、150天等具体门槛均依据 BPC 摘要，报道未提供独立核对。

titles.en: Senate passes permitting overhaul with route for solar developers to sue agencies
